content.title: SMX And A*STAR Plan Molecular Tagging System To Transform Singapore's Plastic Waste
content.summary: SMX (Security Matters) PLC (NASDAQ:SMX) and Singapore’s Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) announced a partnership Tuesday to build a national plastic traceability system that uses molecular tagging and blockchain technology. The effort aims to increase recycling rates and reduce incineration, advancing the country’s Zero Waste Masterplan.
